roles.name: Enforcer
powers: You may recharge an ally to add 1d6 plus its adventure deck number to your combat check; you may instead banish it to add 2d6 (☐ 3d6) (☐ 3d8) plus its adventure deck number.

When you play a boon that has the Corrupted or Shield (☐ or Heavy Armor) trait for its power, you may shuffle a random card from your (☐ or another character at your location's) discard pile into your deck.
☐ When you would discard a weapon for its power, you may recharge it instead. (☐ If the weapon has the Sword or Whip trait, you may shuffle it into your deck instead.)
☐ Another character at your location may discard a card to add 1d6 (☐ 1d10) and the Melee trait to her combat check.
☐ When you defeat a monster, you may examine the top card (☐ or top 2 cards) of your location deck.

roles.name: Knight of the Rack
powers: You may recharge an ally to add 1d6 plus its adventure deck number to your combat (☐ or Charisma or Constitution) check; you may instead banish (☐ or bury) it to add 2d6 (☐ 3d6) plus its adventure deck number.

When you play a boon that has the Corrupted or Shield trait for its power, you may shuffle a random card (☐ or 2 random cards) from your (☐ or another character at your location's) discard pile into your deck.
☐ When you acquire an ally, you may draw a random ally from the box; keep 1 and banish the other. (☐ You may do this with weapons that have the Melee trait.)

☐ When a character at your location acquires a boon of her favored card type, that character may banish it to shuffle the top card (☐ or 2 cards) of the blessings discard pile into the blessings deck.
